say:1:1060000301:0.text: When you see those adorable ducklings, just tag along, and you can herd them back home!
say:1:1060000301:0.source_cn: 找到可爱的小鸭子之后，跟在它们身后就可以把它们赶回家了~
say:1:1060000301:0.male: When you see those adorable ducklings, just tag along, and you can herd them back home!
say:1:1060000301:0.female: When you see those adorable ducklings, just tag along, and you can herd them back home!

say:4:1060000302:0.text: Looks like the duckies didn't show up here. What do you think, Merlin? Shall we check with their owner?
say:4:1060000302:0.source_cn: 小鸭子们好像没来这边。梅林，要不要回去问问它们的主人？
